notes.title: Mission and Equipment selection menu bug fix
notes.notes: There was a bug on the mission and equipment selection menus. Controller input would not work, only keyboard input. Now players should be able to use the controller input for mission and equipment selection.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the input configuration to not display when on the level select screen or during a mission. Players now should be able to change input configuration without issues.
[*] Fixed the music bug. Certain gameplay scenarios were causing multiple music tracks to play at the same time. This should not be an issue anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: Auto-pause bug fix
notes.notes:
The game had a bug where it would automatically pause the game if there was no gamepad connected.
The issue has been corrected and players with no gamepad should be able to play the game without this issue now.
